{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Data Service''' was a messaging service available to the citizens of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. However, it was not secure, and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] often [[Spy/Legends|spied]] on the message contents. As a result, most citizens used courier services to send messages, or, in the case of [[Corellian Merchants' Guild/Legends|Corellian Merchants' Guild]] members, used the guild's free message service.
